name: Cleave
description: Sweep in a wide arc. Every third swing is a leaping blow that hits harder and throws enemies back.

name: Thunderclap
description: Slam the ground and hurl back everything around you, setting it alight.

name: Storm Bolt
description: A bolt of lightning that passes through the first enemy it hits.

name: Dodge Roll
description: Roll toward the cursor. Nothing hits you early in the roll, and it cuts an attack short.

name: Death Burst
description: What it held breaks loose.

name: Mended Rhythm
description: The same two steps and the same blow, again and again.

name: Needle
description: A thrown needle trailing thread.

name: Stitch
description: Thread is drawn through a fallen body until it stands again.

name: Haymaker
description: A long lopsided wind-up, then the whole weight comes down.

name: Fault Slam
description: The maul strikes a narrow line of sparks through the ground ahead.

name: Snatch
description: It crouches, springs, and drags what it catches back with it.

name: Thrown Stone
description: A stone, a bottle, a boot: whatever is in hand.

name: Split Stones
description: Two stones fly to either side of the target.

name: Echo Healing Pulse
description: The Echo Healer gathers light, then restores life to nearby allies.

name: Borrowed Blow
description: A wide cut, swung the way someone else once swung it.

name: Overhead Blow
description: A slow blow straight down in front.

name: Thrown Stone
description: A block of stone, thrown hard.

name: Ground Slam
description: Both hands down. The floor answers.

name: Cold Grasp
description: A slow reach that does not stop.

name: Slowed Hour
description: Time thickens over a patch of ground. Anything inside moves at half its pace.

name: Held Moment
description: A brass-bright line that stops its target for a heartbeat.

name: Held Hours
description: Three brass lines at once, fanned wide. Each one stops what it touches.

name: Rank Thrust
description: A short thrust from behind a raised shield.

name: Echo Hex
description: It sends a narrow shot that leaves a brief mark. A different attack bursts the mark.

name: Echo Hex Burst
description: The mark bursts on a follow-up hit.

name: Tally Mark
description: A pale stroke that marks its target. The next blow from anyone else lands with the count behind it.

name: Due
description: The mark is called in all at once.

name: Set Back in Line
description: A fallen keeper is lifted and set back in its place.

name: Clear the Floor
description: A flat blow of the rod that pushes everything near it away.

name: Marshal's Sweep
description: A slow, wide sweep that clears the space in front of the line.

name: Replayed Cut
description: A cut, and a moment later the same cut again from where it was made.

name: Replayed Sweep
description: A wide sweep that happens twice.

name: Struck Hour
description: A ring of force bursts out, then bursts again.

name: Staff Sweep
description: A wide sweep of a heavy walking staff.

name: Cleave
description: Your own sweep, swung back at you.

name: Storm Bolt
description: Your own bolts, thrown three at a time.

name: Thunderclap
description: Your own thunder, slower to gather.

name: Forkline
description: Lightning that jumps from enemy to enemy, a little weaker each time.

name: Mist Step
description: Turn to mist and reappear where you aim, throwing aside whatever stands there.

name: Undertow
description: A whirlpool where you aim drags enemies together, then pulls them under.

name: Squall
description: A storm forms where you stand and strikes everything under it every half second.

name: Thunderhead
description: Hold to charge, release to strike. The longer you hold, the harder and wider it lands.

name: Static Brand
description: Charge the first enemy it touches. Hit that enemy with anything else and the charge bursts around it.

name: Brand Burst
description: A stored charge let go all at once.

name: Living Wire
description: Hold a line of lightning on your target. It burns everything along it while you hold.

name: Held Breath
description: For a few heartbeats everything near you moves at a crawl. You do not.

name: Mending Pulse
description: Light spreads out from you and closes wounds: you and every ally it reaches regain 10 life and 12% of their maximum life.

name: Storm Lance
description: Storm Bolt becomes a lance: one straight line of lightning that strikes everything along it at once.

name: Standing Thunder
description: Thunderclap becomes a storm that stays around you, striking everything close every half second.

name: Whirling Cleave
description: Cleave becomes a full turn: it strikes all around you, but no longer builds to an overhead blow.

name: Millwheel
description: Hold Cleave to keep turning as you run: every enemy struck builds momentum, which turns you faster, widens your reach and keeps you on your feet. Each hit gives back a little mana, and 3% of the damage it deals comes back as life, half as much from a rare and a quarter from a boss; turning through empty air only spends it.

press.hint: Hold to keep turning; you can run while it turns

name: Thunder Leap
description: Thunderhead becomes a leap: you come down where you aim and the storm comes down with you.

name: Shadow Step
description: Dodge Roll becomes a step through the shadow to where you aim, throwing aside whatever you arrive in.

name: Breaker
description: Undertow becomes a breaker: a wave bursts out around you and hurls everything away.

name: Gathered Clap
description: Thunderclap can be held: the longer you gather it, the wider and harder the ring, and the ground it leaves burning drags them back in.

name: Heaving Cleave
description: Cleave can be held: release a single heavy sweep that throws enemies far back and sets them burning.

name: Firewheel
description: Hold Cleave to keep turning a burning weapon as you run: everything it strikes is set burning, and the ground behind you keeps burning. Every enemy struck builds momentum, which turns you faster, widens your reach and keeps you on your feet. Each hit gives back a little mana; turning through empty air only spends it.

press.hint: Hold to keep turning; you can run while it burns

name: Twice-Told Bolt
description: Storm Bolt happens twice: a moment after the bolt, its echo flies the same way again.

name: Haymaker
description: A long, slow, telegraphed swing: there is time to step away.

name: Thrown Stone
description: A lazy lob that is easy to sidestep.

name: Quarrel
description: Loose a bolt that drives through the first enemy it hits.

name: Fanned Quarrel
description: Quarrel looses a fan of bolts across the way ahead, each lighter than a single shot.

name: Heavy Quarrel
description: Quarrel can be held: release one heavy bolt that drives through the line and throws enemies far back.

name: Pounce
description: A running leap that ends in a bite.

name: Bite
description: A quick snap at the ankles.

name: Bite
description: It circles out of reach, drops on you, bites and climbs away again.

name: Leap
description: It waits until you are close, then lands on you.

name: Lunge
description: It lies still in the grit until you come close, then skims at you in a straight line and drives its tail in.

name: Stone Rupture
description: The crawler strikes the ground. Three spots crack in a row, then erupt one after another.

name: Web
description: It spits a wad of web where you stand. The web clings, stings, and holds you to half your pace.

name: Silk Pin
description: A straight shot of silk that briefly pins what it hits in place.

name: Smother
description: It heaves itself onto you, and the silt it lands in clings to your legs.

name: Clinging Silt
description: Wet silt where it landed. It drags at your feet.

name: Crackle Burst
description: Its charge gathers where it fell, then bursts in a short flash of storm.

name: Spine Volley
description: It clenches and throws three spines in a fan.

name: Bite
description: It lies still as a mushroom until you are close, then bites.

name: Spore Burst
description: It bursts as it dies. Stand clear of the cloud.

name: Dive
description: It circles at the edge of the light, then drops on you and is gone again.

name: Rift Rush
description: It marks a spot before blinking into it with a short burst.

name: Grasp
description: It hangs back in the dark and drags you in with its arms.

name: Bite
description: A hop and a bite.

name: Brood Crash
description: It rears up on its back legs and drops its whole weight where you were standing.

name: Wisp Volley
description: A purple light gathers at the hand, swells, then breaks into a quick volley of wisps that leave dust hanging behind them.

name: Ghost Wave
description: A low horn, and a pale wave rolls out ahead through everything in its way; its echoes follow it down the same path, each one fainter.

name: Spell Strike
description: A flick of the hand and a knot of light snaps into the nearest enemy ahead, with a crack of dust off the ground.

name: Fire Burst
description: Flame snaps alight in the hand and bursts on the ground a few steps ahead; whatever it catches keeps burning.

name: Fire Slam
description: Bring the weapon down and the ground splits into a straight line of fire ahead of you. Everything on it is struck, thrown aside and set burning, and the line keeps burning.

name: Burning Line
description: The ground a Fire Slam split, still burning.

name: Firewall
description: Fire Slam becomes Firewall: hold and drag across the ground to draw a wall of fire. While it burns, monsters cannot cross it, and anything touching it burns. Up to 14 m of wall stands at once; draw more and the oldest part burns out first.

press.hint: Hold and drag across the ground to draw the wall

name: Firewall
description: A wall of fire drawn on the ground. Monsters cannot cross it while it burns.

name: Thrown Into the Fire
description: Thrown against a burning wall.

name: Bellows
description: Thunderclap becomes Bellows: a blast of hot air bursts where you aim and throws everything in it outward, setting it burning. Anything thrown into your Firewall slams against it and burns.

name: Flashover
description: Banked Fire becomes Flashover: every piece of Firewall you have drawn flares at once, the flare running along the walls away from you. Everything near a wall is struck hard and set burning. The air around you flares too.

name: Flashover
description: A drawn wall flaring all at once.

name: Flicker
description: Dodge Roll becomes a flicker of flame: you vanish and reappear where you aim, and the ground you left keeps burning.

name: Flicker
description: The ground a Flicker left, still burning.

name: Firewheel Trail
description: The ground a Firewheel turned through, still burning.

name: Standing Storm
description: A storm stays around you, striking everything close every half second and healing you for each enemy it strikes.

name: Static Field
description: The air around you grows heavy with charge for 30 seconds. Enemies inside it take 20% more damage from lightning skills, your lightning skills recharge 20% sooner, and you regain 4 more mana every second.

name: Umbra
description: A shadow spreads around you: enemies inside it deal 15% less damage, and it bites them every second.

name: Heat
description: The ground itself is burning.

name: Cinder Pounce
description: It runs, leaps, and the ground it lands on keeps burning.

name: Great Cinder Pounce
description: A longer leap, and a wider patch of ground left burning.

name: Slag Crash
description: It rears, hangs, and drops its whole weight where you were standing.

name: Elder Crash
description: The ground splits under the weight.

name: Eruption
description: What kept it whole was molten. It breaks open.

name: Great Eruption
description: It breaks open wide.

name: Ember Spit
description: A gob of molten rock, thrown to where you will be.

name: Molten Spit
description: A heavier gob, thrown far ahead.

name: Cinder Bite
description: A hot snap at the ankles.

name: Burning Ground
description: The ground where it landed, still burning.

name: Burning Ground
description: The ground where it landed, still burning.

name: Riptide
description: Roll further toward the cursor on a surge of water, leaving a rip current where you land that drags enemies in after you.

name: Rip Current
description: A rip current that drags enemies into it and strikes them.

name: Millrace
description: Throw a wave of water out where you aim: it runs along the ground and crashes through everything in its way. It spends all the Millwheel's momentum, and the more you hold the harder, wider and farther it runs. Everything it strikes is stunned, for 0.6 s with no momentum up to 1.5 s at full; a stunned monster shakes off the next stun for 4 s after, and rares and bosses shake it off sooner.

name: Shoulder Through
description: Drive your shoulder toward the cursor. Nothing hits you early in the charge, and where you stop the ground flares, throwing enemies back and setting them alight.

name: Flare
description: The ground flares where a shoulder charge stops.

name: Smouldering Wake
description: Ground left burning where a smouldering monster walked.

name: Gathered Embers
description: The ground a gathered clap leaves burning, dragging enemies back into it.

name: Banked Fire
description: A fire banked around you strikes everything close every second, and burns hotter with every strike.

name: Measured Sweep
description: A wide sweep, then the same sweep again.

name: Held Line
description: A straight brass line that holds what it touches.

name: Struck Hour
description: A ring of force bursts out, then bursts again.

name: Tally Row
description: A row of marks laid through where you stand, struck one after another.

name: Quarter Hands
description: Four lines thrown crosswise, then four more turned between them.

name: Counted
description: A mark under your feet that strikes once it is counted.
